snippet.title: Now Available On iOS and Android | Hot Wheels: Race Off | Hot Wheels Gaming | @HotWheels
snippet.description:
Race, stunt, and collect in an epic new game from Hot Wheels! 

Everything you love about Hot Wheels brought to life in an awesome racing game:
- RACE 30+ Hot Wheels cars across 40+ insane physics racing tracks
- BLAST OFF of boosters, loops, and jumps to stunt on the iconic Hot Wheels orange track
- UPGRADE AND BUILD YOUR COLLECTION of Hot Wheels cars
- CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS and the world in competitive multi-player mode

#HotWheels #HotWheelsGaming

Watch the latest Hot Wheels videos: http://bit.ly/HW_MostRecent

WATCH ALL OF THE HOT WHEELS SERIES:
🏙 Hot Wheels City: http://bit.ly/HotWheels_HWC
🏝Monster Trucks Island: http://bit.ly/HotWheels_MTI
⚔️ Monster Trucks Tournament of Titans: http://bit.ly/HotWheels_MTToT
🎥 Monster Trucks LIVE: http://bit.ly/HotWheels_MTLive
🔬Labs Unlimited: http://bit.ly/HotWheels_LU
 🏎 World of Hot Wheels: http://bit.ly/HotWheels_WOHW
🚒 ALL Monster Truck Series: http://bit.ly/HotWheels_MT

About Hot Wheels:
Welcome to the official Hot Wheels YouTube Channel! Check out the coolest toys, the craziest stunts, the fastest action, and the most epic races on our channel! Go behind the scenes for exclusive content, jump behind the wheel of World Record-breaking stunts, jumps and loops, and show us how you perform the craziest stunts on orange track! Stay up to date on our episodic content by subscribing now!

Now Available On iOS and Android | Hot Wheels: Race Off | Hot Wheels Gaming | @Hot Wheels
https://www.youtube.com/c/hotwheels
